policy.include: Include a candidate when the Oxford B1-C1 part of speech/sense matches the use in the script. Add all occurrences in Block 2. Important idioms, British/dated expressions and context-sensitive lower-level phrases may also be included.
policy.exclude: Exclude only when the Oxford B1-C1 entry is a different part of speech/sense, or when the candidate was created by a deliberately broad morphology heuristic rather than the actual script lemma.
policy.context: The Block 2 dramatic outline is authoritative for contextual interpretation.
